Lift the cup and saucer slightly above the counter, with a restrained teal edge around its virtual display footprint and a separated soft shadow. prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: compact 16:9 landscape educational UI illustration for a printed design booklet. Render a fresh concrete future-direction example for the neutral Italian café CAFFÈ LUCE. A calm ivory-and-teal desktop interface demonstrates a task-specific structured proposal with visible human control, NOT a chat conversation or a whole booklet page.
Composition: one clean compact application panel, mostly filling the 16:9 frame, with generous spacing and very large readable dark-teal typography. A thin restrained teal header carries the brand "CAFFÈ LUCE". Under it show the explicit user request "Una pausa per due" as a large single request line, not a speech bubble. Main heading "La tua pausa". A small but clearly legible source strip labeled "Menu del locale" identifies grounding. Under the heading show THREE distinct useful product rows with small crisp simple café product illustrations at left, large exact labels in the middle and simple editable quantity controls at right. Each quantity control is visibly a minus button, a number, and a plus button, not an action that has already executed.
Row labels and sensible editable quantities:
"Caffè"    − 1 +
"Croissant"    − 2 +
"Tè"    − 1 +
Coffee illustration is one espresso cup with saucer, croissant one recognizable pastry, tea one cup of amber tea. Keep illustrations compact; labels and controls are the dominant useful content.
Below the rows show exact clear status "Proposta da verificare". At bottom show TWO large actions side by side: "Modifica" as an outlined teal button and "Conferma" as a filled teal button. The composition visibly remains a proposal awaiting a person's review, not a purchase confirmation. There is no total, no prices, no invented arithmetic, no score or AI performance metrics.
Exact sparse copy ONLY: "CAFFÈ LUCE", "Una pausa per due", "La tua pausa", "Menu del locale", "Caffè", "Croissant", "Tè", "Proposta da verificare", "Modifica", "Conferma". Preserve spelling, capitalization and accents perfectly.
Typography: clear large rounded humanist sans-serif, dark teal on opaque ivory. Design so EVERY label remains readable when the WHOLE image is shown at only 350 pixels wide; avoid small notes, tiny browser chrome or lots of dense extra controls. Large simple row labels, quantity digits and button labels, consistent calm hierarchy. No speech bubbles, no chatbot avatar, no decoration that competes with content, no extra copy, no footer, no captions outside the UI, no watermark. Output landscape 16:9, ideally 1600×900, sharp high-quality raster.
Use a WIDE 16:9 frame. The entire compact composition must be legible in a 350×197 printed demonstration image; make labels unusually large, remove any nonessential surrounding padding, and avoid a distant device mockup. Keep every label inside the frame.

qa.note: Passed: quantity controls show Caffè 1, Croissant 2, Tè 1; review status precedes Modifica/Conferma. Large readable labels.
